composition_strategy: Create a composition where lush natural foliage dominates, presenting a panoramic view of a botanical garden from a low angle, emphasizing the height and density of the foliage. Use the central band of the image to highlight the most vibrant and varied foliage, while the edges of the frame are used for quieter, more subtle elements that still contribute to the cohesive botanical garden atmosphere.
focal_strategy: Place the focal point on a particularly vibrant and lush section of the botanical garden, featuring a variety of leaf textures and colors. This focal area should capture the essence of the botanical garden, drawing the eye with its rich green hues and elegant cream accents.
depth_strategy: Achieve a sense of depth by layering foliage from the foreground to the background, with the most detailed and vibrant foliage in the foreground and a softer, more blurred foliage in the background, creating an immersive natural landscape.
border_or_perimeter_strategy: The perimeter of the image will be treated with a subtle blend of foliage edges, ensuring that the botanical garden atmosphere is consistent throughout the entire frame, with no abrupt transitions or empty spaces.
title_safe_region_strategy: Create a safe-space for the title by positioning a slightly lighter area of foliage along the top third of the image, ensuring that the text will be clearly visible against the green background.
programme_safe_region_strategy: Designate a safe-space for the programme information by incorporating a subtle, uniform area near the bottom of the image, ensuring it contrasts well with the green foliage while maintaining the botanical garden aesthetic.
